_meta.note: Five leftover State House: Ireland R-IN; Delperdang R-KS; Lawson R-IN; Mayfield D-IL; O'Mara D-PA.

1.note: Campaign home, Making Indy Safe Again: 'Andrew backs law enforcement, stands with victims, and is taking on the revolving-door policies that put violent criminals back on our streets.' The same page lists co-authoring HB 1006, 'Held rogue prosecutors accountable.'

3.note: Campaign Platform page: he 'still believes in states' rights' under the 10th Amendment and says one of his primary goals in Topeka is to 'bring more power back to the state and closer to the people,' quoting Reagan on powers reserved to the states or to the people.

0.note: Campaign Endorsements page: Lawson said he is 'proud to stand with our farmers, small business entrepreneurs, and the first responders who put their lives on the line to keep us safe.' Indiana State Police Alliance executive director Cory Martin said Lawson 'supports us on critical law enforcement issues.'

Campaign Issues page, Women's Reproductive Rights: 'It is not the place for government to tell women what they can or cannot do with their bodies. I will continue to hold the line here in Illinois and protect choice.'

3.note: Campaign home, under Voting by Mail: it invites voters to 'request your mail in ballot' and to 'Find your nearest drop box here.'
